description: Paths for showing files: resolved inside the project folder or a data location's root, never outside it (.. or an absolute path), with whether they exist; revealing a missing file is an error. Listing a folder gives folders first, then files, by name, and can be cut short. Reveal is not run on an existing path here, since it would open a file browser. Opening a file refuses a folder, a missing file and a path outside; a file that is there is not opened here, since that would start an app.
